test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As on 1st November 2022, who is the chairperson of SEBI’s Market Data Advisory Committee (MDAC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M.S. Sahoo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As on **1st November 2022**, the chairperson of **SEBI’s Market Data Advisory Committee (MDAC)** was** M S Sahoo,**
 
• He is the **professor** at **National Law University, Delhi** and **former chairperson of Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI).**
 
• MDAC stands for **Market Data Advisory Committee. **
 
• It is a standing committee constituted by SEBI to recommend appropriate policy for access to** securities market data, identify segment-wise data perimeters, data needs and gaps, and recommend data privacy and data access regulations** applicable to market data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****SEBI**

 
• SEBI stands for **Securities and Exchange Board of India.**
 
• The** headquarters** of SEBI is situated in** Mumbai**. The **regional offices** of SEBI are located in **Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Chennai, and Delhi.**
 
• It is a statutory regulatory body established by the Government of India in **1992 **to protect the interests of investors investing in securities and to regulate the securities market.
 
• SEBI also **regulates how the stock market and mutual funds function.**
